rules.name: family-lots-01-check
rules.sql: WITH cut AS ( SELECT max(v.value_date) AS d FROM opera.valuation_date_table v WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant AND v.business_unit = :bu ), fam AS ( SELECT t.parent_trade_id, t.trade_id, abs(t.original_lots) * s.sign AS signed_lots, s.is_initial_trade FROM opera.deal_ticket_table t JOIN opera.market_action_sign_mapping_table s ON s.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND s.market_action = t.market_action WHERE t.tenant_id = :tenant AND t.business_unit = :bu AND t.is_latest_version = 1 AND t.parent_trade_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.deal_ticket_table k WHERE k.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND k.business_unit = t.business_unit AND k.parent_trade_id = t.parent_trade_id AND k.is_latest_version = 1 AND k.trade_id <> k.parent_trade_id) ), tot AS ( SELECT parent_trade_id, sum(signed_lots) AS family_sum FROM fam GROUP BY parent_trade_id ), exp AS ( SELECT f.parent_trade_id, f.trade_id, (f.trade_id = f.parent_trade_id) AS is_parent, t.family_sum * f.is_initial_trade AS expected_lots FROM fam f JOIN tot t ON t.parent_trade_id = f.parent_trade_id ), act AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.trade_id) a.trade_id, a.value_date, a.active_lots FROM opera.deal_active_lots_table a, cut WHERE a.tenant_id = :tenant AND a.business_unit = :bu AND a.value_date <= cut.d AND a.trade_id IN (SELECT trade_id FROM exp) ORDER BY a.trade_id, a.value_date DESC ) SELECT CASE WHEN e.is_parent THEN 'parent' ELSE 'child' END AS role, count(*) AS family_members, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.trade_id IS NULL) AS no_lots_row, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.trade_id IS NOT NULL AND abs(coalesce(a.active_lots, 0) - coalesce(e.expected_lots, 0)) < 0.000001) AS agree, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.trade_id IS NOT NULL AND abs(coalesce(a.active_lots, 0) - coalesce(e.expected_lots, 0)) >= 0.000001) AS differ FROM exp e LEFT JOIN act a ON a.trade_id = e.trade_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH cut AS ( SELECT max(v.value_date) AS d FROM opera.valuation_date_table v WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant AND v.business_unit = :bu ), fam AS ( SELECT t.parent_trade_id, t.trade_id, t.market_action, abs(t.original_lots) * s.sign AS signed_lots, s.is_initial_trade FROM opera.deal_ticket_table t JOIN opera.market_action_sign_mapping_table s ON s.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND s.market_action = t.market_action WHERE t.tenant_id = :tenant AND t.business_unit = :bu AND t.is_latest_version = 1 AND t.parent_trade_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.deal_ticket_table k WHERE k.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND k.business_unit = t.business_unit AND k.parent_trade_id = t.parent_trade_id AND k.is_latest_version = 1 AND k.trade_id <> k.parent_trade_id) ), tot AS ( SELECT parent_trade_id, sum(signed_lots) AS family_sum FROM fam GROUP BY parent_trade_id ), exp AS ( SELECT f.parent_trade_id, f.trade_id, f.market_action, (f.trade_id = f.parent_trade_id) AS is_parent, t.family_sum, t.family_sum * f.is_initial_trade AS expected_lots FROM fam f JOIN tot t ON t.parent_trade_id = f.parent_trade_id ), act AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.trade_id) a.trade_id, a.value_date, a.active_lots FROM opera.deal_active_lots_table a, cut WHERE a.tenant_id = :tenant AND a.business_unit = :bu AND a.value_date <= cut.d AND a.trade_id IN (SELECT trade_id FROM exp) ORDER BY a.trade_id, a.value_date DESC ) SELECT e.parent_trade_id, e.trade_id, e.market_action, e.is_parent, e.family_sum, e.expected_lots, a.value_date AS lots_row_date, a.active_lots AS actual_lots FROM exp e LEFT JOIN act a ON a.trade_id = e.trade_id WHERE a.trade_id IS NULL OR abs(coalesce(a.active_lots, 0) - coalesce(e.expected_lots, 0)) >= 0.000001 ORDER BY e.parent_trade_id, e.is_parent DESC LIMIT 500

expect.reason: the BU has families with child tickets
every family member has a lots row
lots agree with the family rule
